title: A Cohesive $\infty$-Topos with a Quantum Modality from Finite-Dimensional $C^{*}$-Algebras
summary: We construct a cohesive $\infty$-topos $\mathbf{H}_{\mathbb{Q}}$ equipped with a \emph{quantum modality} -- an idempotent product-preserving comonad $Q^{\diamond}$ with right adjoint $Q_{\bullet}$ satisfying the Beck--Chevalley compatibility conditions with the cohesive structure $(Π,\flat,\sharp)$. The model is the functor $\infty$-topos $\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf{C}^{*}\mathbf{Alg}_{\mathrm{fd}},\; \mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{sm}})$, where $\mathbf{H}_{\mathrm{sm}}$ is the smooth cohesive $\infty$-topos and $\mathbf{C}^{*}\mathbf{Alg}_{\mathrm{fd}}$ is the category of finite-dimensional…
